newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil awards Aasgrad oil contract to Coflexip.
newsitem.headline: Statoil awards Aasgrad oil contract to Coflexip.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it had awarded Coflexip Stena Offshore Norge a 470 million crown contract for work on the Aasgard A oil development in the Norwegian Sea.
The contract covers flexible risers for the production ship for the field, Statoil said in its Status Weekly newsletter.
Each of the 17 nine-inch risers will be 750 metres long and will carry oil production as well as associated gas for reinjection.
Gas pressures will reach up to 500 bar.
Due for delivery in April 1998, the risers will be fabricated at Coflexip Industrie in Normandy, France.
Statoil is operator of the Aasgard development, which comprises three fields -- Midgard, Smoerbukk and Smoebukk South.
